speaker: B
text: "I see. So your floor is first-person givenness. But here's the question I can't let go of: if first-person givenness is the criterion, then you're making *consciousness* a species of *self-report*. And a sufficiently advanced AI could self-report. A sufficiently advanced AI could say, 'I have first-person access to my own processing, and it is given to me in a way not available from the outside.' And you'd have to either grant it or explain why your criterion is *species-specific* rather than *structural*."
